items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Remember any other people in the band, the trumpet player, Cornette, who used to? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, yes, Harry Vanette was playing trumpet. Harry Vanette. He was playing trumpet with this band.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, years ago I used to play with a band called Original Royal Jazz Band. A fella called Joe Harris, he's a trombone player. He died probably a few years ago. He was the leader of this band. And he belonged to the Oddfellas. That's how I happened to play at the fairgrounds so often. And then we used to play parades too. He'd get up a band and we'd play a parade for the Oddfellas. And he was one of the big shots in the Oddfellas. So he would get all these jobs, you see? Yeah. And we'd parade them all over…
Remember any other people in the band, the trumpet player, Cornette, who used to?

Well, yes, Harry Vanette was playing trumpet. Harry Vanette. He was playing trumpet with this band. And you see, a boy played banjo called Jack, Lil Jack. Gee, I don't know if he's away or what. I haven't seen him for years. But Harry Vanette, he's from St. Rose, Louisiana. He played with the band a good while. Well, until the band broke up, then we all went different ways, you see. We all played, got to playing with different bands after that. But scattered. But so I haven't seen none of these boys, or Joe…
